# Model comparison (generated by scripts/render_model_comparison.py)

All models evaluated on the same full completion projection (31,509 cases). `n/c` = not computable (finite-state metric on an unbounded net). `(certified)` = exact-replay ceiling or dead-transition count from exact rational certificates, not from replay.
